Package au.csiro.pathling.terminology.local

package au.csiro.pathling.terminology.local
  • Related Packages

    Description
    au.csiro.pathling.terminology
     
    au.csiro.pathling.terminology.local.index
     
  • Class
    Description
    AmbiguousVersionException
    Thrown when an unversioned terminology reference cannot be resolved to a single default version, because more than one candidate version (or SNOMED CT edition) is present and none can be preferred.
    CodeSystemEntry
    A single imported code system version, as recorded in the store's code_system table.
    ComposeResult
    The result of translating a FHIR ValueSet compose (or expansion) to the local evaluation model: the code system the value set evaluates over and the VCL expression that defines its members.
    ComposeTranslator
    Translates a FHIR ValueSet.compose (or an enumerated expansion when there is no compose) into the VCL expression model that the local evaluator understands.
    DialectResolver
    Resolves a requested language tag to the SNOMED CT language reference set that serves it, which is what decides which of a concept's synonyms is its preferred term.
    ExpansionCache
    A bounded, per-JVM cache of value set expansions, keyed by value set URL and resolved code system version.
    LanguagePreference
    Reads a weighted language preference list into the dialects to try, in the order to try them, as RFC 9110 describes.
    LocalTerminologyService
    A TerminologyService that resolves the terminology functions against a local, imported terminology store with no network dependency.
    LocalTerminologyServiceFactory
    A serialisable TerminologyServiceFactory that builds a LocalTerminologyService on each executor JVM, memoised once per distinct store configuration within the JVM.
    ResolvedValueSet
    The outcome of resolving a value set URL against the store: the code system version the value set evaluates over and the VCL expression that defines its members.
    ValueSetResolver
    Resolves a value set URL to the code system version it evaluates over and the VclExpression that defines its members.
    ValueSetStore
    The catalogue of imported FHIR ValueSet resources, keyed by canonical URL and version.
    VclEvaluator
    Evaluates a VclExpression against the runtime indexes of one code system version, producing the set of member concepts as a RoaringBitmap of dense identifiers.
    VersionResolver
    Resolves the default (latest) version from a set of candidate versions of the same code system, replicating the version-ordering behaviour of the reference terminology server (Ontoserver's FhirResourceUtils).
